title: DUET: Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation for Low-Resource Languages
abstract: arXiv:2611.30273v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Morphological segmentation, the task of decomposing words into constituent morphemes, becomes particularly challenging under extreme data scarcity, a regime that can arise in language documentation and linguistic reasoning. This difficulty stems from existing approaches' reliance on annotated data, external resources, or recurring patterns that emerge only in larger corpora. To address this limitation, we propose Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation (DUET), a deterministic unsupervised algorithm that decouples structural candidate generation from statistical candidate ranking. DUET combines branching entropy with recursive paradigm discovery to generate linguistically plausible candidate segmentations, then ranks them using a dual minimum description length (MDL) criterion: a corpus-level objective rewards morpheme reuse, while a construction-tree objective guards against over-segmentation. translated_title: DUET：面向低资源语言的双MDL无监督熵-字典树形态切分
translated_abstract: 形态切分，即将词语分解为其组成语素的任务，在极端数据稀缺的情况下变得尤为困难，这种情形可能出现在语言记录和语言推理过程中。这一困难源于现有方法对标注数据、外部资源或仅在较大语料库中才会显现的重复模式的依赖。为解决这一局限，我们提出了双MDL无监督熵-字典树切分算法（DUET），这是一种确定性的无监督算法，它将结构候选生成与统计候选排序解耦。DUET将分支熵与递归式范式发现相结合，生成语言学上合理的候选切分，然后使用双重最小描述长度（MDL）准则对候选进行排序：语料库层面的目标函数奖励语素复用，而构词树层面的目标函数则防止过度切分。在SIGMORPHON 2023行间标注数据（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出DUET算法，通过将分支熵与递归范式发现相结合生成候选切分，并采用双重MDL准则在奖励语素复用与防止过度切分之间取得平衡，实现了无需标注数据和外部资源的低资源语言无监督形态切分。
en_tdlr: DUET is a deterministic unsupervised morphological segmentation algorithm for low-resource languages that combines branching entropy with recursive paradigm discovery for candidate generation and a dual-MDL criterion to reward morpheme reuse while guarding against over-segmentation.
